crie.purpose: Strategy-selected keyword + semantic retrieval and candidate merge (§258/§458-461).

nodes.name: When Called by WF-002
nodes.notes: inputSource 'passthrough' (lowercase t) per the frozen SW I/O contract.

nodes.name: Embed Query
nodes.notes: §459 query embedding. Model must match the stored vectors (R-09 vector(1536)).

nodes.name: Attach Embedding
nodes.notes: Fails loudly on a dimension mismatch instead of letting Postgres error opaquely.

parameters.query: WITH q AS (SELECT '{{ JSON.stringify($('Attach Embedding').first().json.queryEmbedding) }}'::vector AS v) SELECT ku.id::text AS "knowledgeUnitId", e.id::text AS "evidenceId", cit.id::text AS "citationId", ku.content AS text, COALESCE(ku.authority_source, 'Internal Notes') AS "sourceType", ku.created_at AS "updatedAt", ku.category, ku.module, ku.feature, d.filename AS document, cit.page, cit.section, 1 - (emb.embedding <=> q.v) AS "semanticScore", 0::float AS "keywordScore", 0::float AS "metadataScore" FROM q, repository.embeddings emb JOIN repository.retrieval_chunks rc ON rc.id = emb.chunk_id JOIN repository.knowledge_units ku ON ku.id = rc.knowledge_unit_id LEFT JOIN repository.evidence e ON e.knowledge_unit_id = ku.id LEFT JOIN repository.citations cit ON cit.evidence_id = e.id LEFT JOIN repository.documents d ON d.id = cit.document_id WHERE 1 - (emb.embedding <=> q.v) >= {{ Number($('Attach Embedding').first().json.config.minimumSimilarity) }} ORDER BY emb.embedding <=> q.v LIMIT {{ Number($('Attach Embedding').first().json.config.topK) }};

nodes.name: Semantic Search
nodes.notes: §459 cosine search over the HNSW index (0013). minimumSimilarity and topK come from config.

parameters.query:
-- §458 Keyword Retrieval. Replaces two defects that made this arm meaningless:
--   (1) plainto_tsquery ANDs every term, so a multi-term requirement matched nothing
--       at all — measured on the real 962-unit corpus, 0 FTS rows for every probe;
--   (2) similarity(ku.content, query) scores the WHOLE unit, so it is length-biased,
--       and a 0.1 floor admitted 501/95/338/43 units including the negative control.
--       That trigram arm WAS the keyword arm, and it ranked by nothing meaningful.
--
-- The arm now has three parts, each measured against the real corpus:
--   candidate set  OR over the stemmed query lexemes (§455: expansion improves recall)
--   score          IDF-weighted coverage: the share of the requirement's total term
--                  information content this unit accounts for. retrieval.yaml authors
--                  keyword.ranking = "BM25", whose defining property is exactly that a
--                  rare term counts for more than a ubiquitous one. Query terms ABSENT
--                  from the corpus stay in the denominator on purpose: their absence is
--                  the evidence that the corpus does not cover the requirement.
--   gate           a plurality of DISTINCT query lexemes, plus a weighted-coverage
--                  floor. The plurality rule is what carries the negative control: on
--                  the real corpus no unit co-mentions two of the SAML/SSO query terms
--                  (0 units, vs 373/31/169 for the three genuine requirements), so the
--                  floor only has to trim the tail and is not load-bearing.
WITH q AS (
  SELECT to_tsquery('{{ $('Attach Embedding').first().json.textSearchConfig }}', $q${{ $('Attach Embedding').first().json.keywordTsQuery }}$q$) AS tsq,
         ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT unnest(tsvector_to_array(
           to_tsvector('{{ $('Attach Embedding').first().json.textSearchConfig }}', $q${{ $('Attach Embedding').first().json.keywordQuery }}$q$)))) AS lex,
         ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT unnest(tsvector_to_array(
           to_tsvector('{{ $('Attach Embedding').first().json.textSearchConfig }}', $q${{ $('Attach Embedding').first().json.keywordCoreQuery }}$q$)))) AS lex_core
),
ku AS (
  SELECT k.id, to_tsvector('{{ $('Attach Embedding').first().json.textSearchConfig }}', k.content) AS tsv
  FROM repository.knowledge_units k
),
n AS (SELECT count(*)::float AS ndoc FROM ku),
idf AS (
  SELECT t.l, ln(1 + (n.ndoc - dc.df + 0.5) / (dc.df + 0.5)) AS idf
  FROM q, unnest(q.lex) AS t(l), n,
       LATERAL (SELECT count(*)::float AS df FROM ku WHERE t.l = ANY(tsvector_to_array(ku.tsv))) dc
),
qs AS (
  -- §455: expansion exists to improve RECALL, so synonym/acronym terms widen the
  -- candidate query and can satisfy the numerator, but the denominator stays the
  -- requirement's OWN terms. Otherwise configuring more synonyms would raise the
  -- bar every unit has to clear and make recall worse.
  SELECT (SELECT sum(i.idf) FROM idf i WHERE i.l = ANY(q.lex_core)) AS idf_total,
         LEAST({{ Number($('Attach Embedding').first().json.minimumMatchedTerms) }}, cardinality(q.lex)) AS min_lex
  FROM q
),
scored AS (
  SELECT ku.id AS ku_id,
         ts_rank_cd(ku.tsv, q.tsq, 32) AS rank,
         cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT unnest(tsvector_to_array(ku.tsv))
                           INTERSECT SELECT unnest(q.lex))) AS nlex,
         LEAST(COALESCE((SELECT sum(i.idf) FROM idf i WHERE i.l = ANY(tsvector_to_array(ku.tsv))), 0)
               / NULLIF(qs.idf_total, 0), 1.0) AS wcov
  FROM ku, q, qs
  WHERE ku.tsv @@ q.tsq
)
SELECT k2.id::text AS "knowledgeUnitId", e.id::text AS "evidenceId", cit.id::text AS "citationId", k2.content AS text, COALESCE(k2.authority_source, 'Internal Notes') AS "sourceType", k2.created_at AS "updatedAt", k2.category, k2.module, k2.feature, d.filename AS document, cit.page, cit.section, 0::float AS "semanticScore", scored.wcov::float AS "keywordScore", 0::float AS "metadataScore"
FROM scored
JOIN repository.knowledge_units k2 ON k2.id = scored.ku_id
LEFT JOIN repository.evidence e ON e.knowledge_unit_id = k2.id
LEFT JOIN repository.citations cit ON cit.evidence_id = e.id
LEFT JOIN repository.documents d ON d.id = cit.document_id
WHERE scored.nlex >= (SELECT min_lex FROM qs)
  AND scored.wcov >= {{ Number($('Attach Embedding').first().json.minimumWeightedCoverage) }}
ORDER BY scored.wcov DESC, scored.rank DESC
LIMIT {{ Number($('Attach Embedding').first().json.config.topK) }};
